title: AR Deep Dive: Artifact Registry Intelligence 360
subtitle: 360-degree deep dive into Harness Artifact Registry activity: push/pull traffic, registries, packages and versions, principals and client IPs, dependency-firewall posture, registry change audit, and supply-chain correlation of AR-hosted digests with SCS SBOM/vulnerability data and CD deployments.

widget.text: # AR Deep Dive: Artifact Registry Intelligence 360

Every Artifact Registry audit event (uploads, downloads, registry create/update/delete, firewall blocks) sliced by registry, package, version digest, principal, client IP and time - then correlated with SCS SBOM/vulnerability data (digest-level join) and CD deployments (image-level join). Use the filters (Organization, Project, Registry, Package Type, Action, User, Registry Type) and the date picker; every widget honours them. Tabs below go from executive summary to forensic tables; registry and package names link into AR.

widget.title: Total AR Events

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | aggregate { count(a.event_id) as events }

widget.subtitle: All audit events in the period (vs previous period)

widget.title: Pull : Push Ratio

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | aggregate { round(1.0 * sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end), 0), 2) as pull_push_ratio }

widget.title: SBOM Coverage of AR Digests

queries.query: with av as ( find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | filter a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] | group_by a.version_name | select { concat("sha256:", substring(a.version_name, 3, 64)) as digest }) find av | left join entity "ssca:artifact" s on s.digest = av.digest | aggregate { 100.0 * distinct_count(s.digest) / nullif(distinct_count(av.digest), 0) as sbom_coverage }

widget.subtitle: AR version digests that have an SBOM in Supply Chain (digest join)

widget.title: Registry Scorecard

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by a.registry_name | select { a.registry_name as registry, count(a.event_id) as events, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, distinct_count(case when a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] then a.package_name end) as packages, distinct_count(case when a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] then a.version_name end) as versions, distinct_count(a.principal_identifier) as principals, max(a.timestamp) as last_activity, round(100.0 * count(a.event_id) / sum(count(a.event_id)) over (), 1) as share_pct } | order_by events desc | limit 50

widget.subtitle: One row per registry: traffic, package/version footprint, principals and share of all AR activity. Click a registry to open it in AR.

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | aggregate { distinct_count(date_trunc("day", a.timestamp)) as active_days }

widget.text: Read top-down: weekly push/pull balance, daily bursts by action, cumulative growth, then *when* AR is used (weekday x hour heatmap, hour-of-day profile) and who drives it (principal type).

widget.title: Push vs Pull Volume with Pull:Push Ratio (dual axis)

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by date_trunc("week", a.timestamp) | select { date_trunc("week", a.timestamp) as week, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, round(1.0 * sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end), 0), 2) as pull_push_ratio } | order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: Weekly uploads and downloads (left axis) against downloads-per-upload (right axis)

widget.title: Daily Events by Action (grouped)

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by date_trunc("day", a.timestamp), a.action | select { date_trunc("day", a.timestamp) as day, a.action as action, count(a.event_id) as events } | order_by day asc

widget.title: Cumulative Pushes & Pulls

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by date_trunc("week", a.timestamp) | select { date_trunc("week", a.timestamp) as week, sum(sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end)) over (order by date_trunc("week", a.timestamp)) as cumulative_uploads, sum(sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end)) over (order by date_trunc("week", a.timestamp)) as cumulative_downloads } | order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: Running totals - the slope is the push/pull rate

widget.title: When Does AR Get Used? Weekday x Hour (UTC) Heatmap

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by case when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 0 then "1 Mon" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 1 then "2 Tue" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 2 then "3 Wed" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 3 then "4 Thu" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 4 then "5 Fri" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 5 then "6 Sat" else "7 Sun" end, date_diff(date_trunc("day", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "hour") | select { case when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 0 then "1 Mon" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 1 then "2 Tue" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 2 then "3 Wed" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 3 then "4 Thu" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 4 then "5 Fri" when date_diff(date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "day") = 5 then "6 Sat" else "7 Sun" end as weekday, date_diff(date_trunc("day", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "hour") as hour_utc, count(a.event_id) as events }

widget.subtitle: Pivot of event counts by weekday (rows) and UTC hour (columns); dense cells show peak usage windows

widget.title: Weekly Events by Principal Type (stacked area)

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by date_trunc("week", a.timestamp), a.principal_type | select { date_trunc("week", a.timestamp) as week, a.principal_type as principal_type, count(a.event_id) as events } | order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: Human vs automated traffic over time

widget.title: Hour-of-Day Profile (UTC)

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by date_diff(date_trunc("day", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "hour") | select { date_diff(date_trunc("day", a.timestamp), a.timestamp, "hour") as hour_utc, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, count(a.event_id) as events } | order_by hour_utc asc

widget.subtitle: Pushes and pulls per UTC hour

widget.title: Month-over-Month Comparison

queries.query: with m as ( find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by date_trunc("month", a.timestamp) | select { date_trunc("month", a.timestamp) as month, count(a.event_id) as events, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, distinct_count(a.principal_identifier) as principals, distinct_count(a.registry_name) as registries }) find m | select { m.month as month, m.events as events, m.uploads as uploads, m.downloads as downloads, m.principals as principals, m.registries as registries, round(100.0 * (m.events - lag(m.events) over (order by m.month)) / nullif(lag(m.events) over (order by m.month), 0), 1) as mom_change_pct } | order_by month desc

widget.subtitle: Monthly totals with month-over-month change in event volume

widget.title: Top Registries by Activity (stacked by action)

queries.query: with r as ( find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by a.registry_name, a.action | select { a.registry_name as registry, a.action as action, count(a.event_id) as events, sum(count(a.event_id)) over (partition by a.registry_name) as reg_total }) find r | filter r.reg_total >= 2 | select { r.registry as registry, r.action as action, r.events as events, r.reg_total as reg_total } | order_by reg_total desc

widget.subtitle: Horizontal stacked bars per registry (registries with >= 2 events)

queries.query: find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | group_by a.registry_name | select { row_number() over (order by count(a.event_id) desc) as rank, a.registry_name as registry, max(case when a.registry_type is null or a.registry_type = "" then "Untyped" else a.registry_type end) as registry_type, max(case when a.package_type is null or a.package_type = "" then "Untyped" else a.package_type end) as package_type, max(a.org_identifier) as org, max(a.project_identifier) as project, count(a.event_id) as events, round(100.0 * count(a.event_id) / sum(count(a.event_id)) over (), 1) as share_pct, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, distinct_count(case when a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] then a.package_name end) as packages, distinct_count(case when a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] then a.version_name end) as versions, max(a.timestamp) as last_seen } | order_by events desc | limit 100

widget.text: Correlations: AR version digest (01<sha256>) = SCS `ssca:artifact.digest` (sha256:<hex>) for SBOM / vulnerability / signing posture; AR package name = CD `service_infra_info.artifact_image` for deployments; AR registry/package = SCS artifact name for the inventory view. STO issue images carry no registry/tag data in this account, so STO signal comes from SCS's STO counters.

widget.title: Digests with SBOM

queries.query: with av as ( find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | filter a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] | group_by a.registry_name, a.package_name, a.version_name | select { a.registry_name as registry, a.package_name as package, concat("sha256:", substring(a.version_name, 3, 64)) as digest, substring(a.version_name, 3, 12) as digest_short, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, count(a.event_id) as events }) find av | join entity "ssca:artifact" s on s.digest = av.digest | aggregate { distinct_count(av.digest) as sbom_digests }

queries.query: with av as ( find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | filter a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] | group_by a.registry_name, a.package_name, a.version_name | select { a.registry_name as registry, a.package_name as package, concat("sha256:", substring(a.version_name, 3, 64)) as digest, substring(a.version_name, 3, 12) as digest_short, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, count(a.event_id) as events }) find av | join entity "ssca:artifact" s on s.digest = av.digest | group_by av.registry, av.package, av.digest_short, av.uploads, av.downloads | select { av.registry as registry, av.package as package, av.digest_short as digest, av.uploads as uploads, av.downloads as downloads, max(s.tag) as scs_tag, max(s.sbom_component_count) as sbom_components, max(s.sto_total_vulnerabilities) as vulnerabilities, max(s.sto_critical) as critical, max(s.sto_high) as high, max(s.sto_medium) as medium, max(case when s.signing_verification_status is null or s.signing_verification_status = "" then "Unsigned/unknown" else s.signing_verification_status end) as signing, max(s.prod_env_count) as prod_envs, max(s.last_seen_millis_ts) as scs_last_seen } | order_by vulnerabilities desc

widget.title: Artifact Lifecycle Chain: Uploaded -> SBOM -> Deployed

queries.query: with ar as ( find view "ar:view:audit_event" a | filter a.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and ${pkgtype_filter_predicate} and ${action_filter_predicate} and ${user_filter_predicate} and ${regtype_filter_predicate} | filter a.package_name not in ["", "NA"] | group_by a.registry_name, a.package_name | select { a.registry_name as registry, a.package_name as package, concat(a.registry_name, "/", a.package_name) as scs_name, sum(case when a.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as uploads, sum(case when a.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downloads, distinct_count(a.version_name) as versions, max(a.timestamp) as last_ar_activity }), cd as (find view "cd:service_infra_info" s | join view "cd:pipeline_execution_summary_cd" p on p.id = s.pipeline_execution_summary_cd_id | filter s.artifact_image != "" | group_by s.artifact_image | select { s.artifact_image as image, distinct_count(s.id) as deployments, distinct_count(s.env_name) as environments, max(s.tag) as last_tag, max(p.row_created_at) as last_deploy }), sc as (find entity "ssca:artifact" s | group_by s.name | select { s.name as name, distinct_count(s.digest) as scs_digests, max(s.sto_total_vulnerabilities) as vulnerabilities }) find ar | left join cd on cd.image = ar.package | left join sc on sc.name = ar.scs_name | select { ar.registry as registry, ar.package as package, ar.uploads as uploads, ar.downloads as downloads, ar.versions as versions, coalesce(sc.scs_digests, 0) as scs_digests, coalesce(sc.vulnerabilities, 0) as vulnerabilities, coalesce(cd.deployments, 0) as cd_deployments, coalesce(cd.environments, 0) as environments, cd.last_tag as last_deployed_tag, case when sc.name is not null then true else false end as has_sbom, case when cd.image is not null then true else false end as deployed, ar.last_ar_activity as last_ar_activity } | order_by uploads desc
